description: This file defines functions and constants related to identifying and handling specific native functions in PyTorch's static runtime configuration, including determining if functions are handwritten and overriding test values for various operations.

methods.name: func_name_base_str
methods.description: Returns the base name of a function or view group for identification.

methods.name: is_hand_written
methods.description: Checks if a given function group corresponds to a handwritten operation based on its name.

methods.name: override_test_values
methods.description: Overrides argument values for specific operations to facilitate testing with randomized data.
